card.line: Ramah was a city that was Samuel's home, where he judged Israel and built an altar to the LORD. Later events there involved kings and prophets.

moments.title: Israel asks for a king
moments.text: The elders of Israel came to Samuel at Ramah and asked him to appoint a king like the other nations. The LORD told Samuel they had rejected Him as their king, and Samuel was to warn them.

moments.title: David runs to Samuel
moments.text: David ran from Saul and went to Samuel at Ramah, then they stayed at Naioth. Saul's messengers and then Saul himself came, but the Spirit of God came upon them and they prophesied.

moments.title: Samuel is buried
moments.text: When Samuel died, all Israel gathered to mourn for him. They buried him at his home in Ramah.

moments.title: Baasha fortifies Ramah
moments.text: Baasha king of Israel fortified Ramah to keep people from leaving or entering Asa's land. When Baasha stopped, Asa's men carried away the stones and timbers and used them to build Geba and Mizpah.

moments.title: Jeremiah is freed
moments.text: Nebuzaradan, the captain of the guard, found Jeremiah in chains at Ramah among the captives headed for Babylon. He released Jeremiah there, and the word of the LORD came to him.
